Package index

Package

What gsm.bio is for and how its statistics are built.

gsm.bio gsm.bio-package
gsm.bio: statistics and widgets for biomarker charts

Statistics

One function per family of tests, each a thin wrapper around the base R function the design names, and all returning the same result.

Analyze_GroupDifference()
Compare a numeric variable between groups
Analyze_Correlation()
Correlate two numeric variables
Analyze_CorrelationMatrix()
Correlate every pair of several numeric variables
Analyze_Fit()
Fit a line or a smooth to two numeric variables
Analyze_Contingency()
Test the association between two categories
Analyze_Survival()
Compare survival between groups
Analyze_Screen()
Screen many biomarkers with one comparison
StatisticsResult statistics-result
The result every statistics function returns

Widgets

A bio.viz chart drawn from R, with its statistics computed by the functions above when the widget is made and stored in the page, so a saved page shows them with no R and no network.

Widget_GroupComparison()
Group Comparison Widget
Widget_AssociationScatter()
Association Scatter Widget
Widget_CorrelationMatrix()
Correlation Matrix Widget

Synthetic study

A made-up biomarker study with three planted effects of known size, for proving the statistics and for the charts to draw.

Synthetic_Results
Synthetic biomarker study: results
Synthetic_Participants
Synthetic biomarker study: participants
Synthetic_Outcomes
Synthetic biomarker study: outcomes
Synthetic_Truth
Synthetic biomarker study: the planted effects and their true sizes
